staybot.subtitle: Frequently asked questions
staybot.greeting: Hi! I'm StayBot. Pick a question from the list and I'll answer right away.
staybot.faq1Q: How do I book a space?
staybot.faq1A: Search for a space you like, pick a date and time (by the hour or by the night), accept the Terms and Conditions, and confirm. If the host has card payments enabled, your booking is confirmed instantly.
staybot.faq2Q: How do I cancel a booking?
staybot.faq2A: Go to "My Bookings" and tap "Cancel booking". The cancellation and refund policy is detailed in our Terms and Conditions.
staybot.faq3Q: Is it safe to pay on Stayfy?
staybot.faq3A: Yes. Card payments are processed securely through Stripe, a globally certified payment provider. Stayfy never stores your card details.
staybot.faq4Q: Can I book by the hour, or only by the night?
staybot.faq4A: Both. Each space shows whether it accepts hourly bookings, nightly bookings, or both — perfect for a short meeting or a multi-night stay alike.
staybot.faq5Q: I own a space — how do I list it and get paid?
staybot.faq5A: Contact the Stayfy team to get your space assigned to you. Then, from your Owner Panel, you can connect your bank account and receive automatic payments for every booking — you keep 100% of your listed price.
staybot.faq6Q: How much commission does Stayfy charge?
staybot.faq6A: The service fee is paid by the guest, on top of the host's listed price — it's never deducted from the owner's payout. Referred users pay a reduced fee on their first booking.
staybot.faq7Q: What languages is Stayfy available in?
staybot.faq7A: Spanish, English, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, German, Turkish, Hebrew, and Italian. Switch languages from the selector at the top of the page.
staybot.faq8A: Email us at the address you signed up with, or contact the host directly from your booking details to coordinate anything about your stay.
